statement: The full peripheral outer centralizer and normalizer of the standard two-section negative torus involution are exactly the explicitly generated Klein four group; the actual conjugacy-orbit fibres are its four-element cosets. For both standard negative involutions, the IA centralizer is trivial. The standard one-section centralizer therefore embeds faithfully as an abelian subgroup of the exact sign and multiplier characters; its multiplier-one subgroup is the specified geometric C2, and its entire torsion subgroup is the specified Klein four group. The remaining one-section multiplier calculation is supplied by D65.
depends_on: D61 exact two standard full extensions; D62 primitive transporter centralizers, unique outside involution or square root, and all-unit transporter formulas; D63 exact characters and finite centralizer bound; full free profinite factor intersection theorem already verified in D35
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part D(b), full loop-outer finite actions in type (1,1)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. All full extension presentations and their kernel maps are explicit, and the dihedral quotients preserve the named peripheral word exactly.
notes: In each standard model C_F(v)=1. A normalized IA centralizer map fixes the actual fusion transporter, then fixes the unique other commuting involution in the two-class model or the unique outside square root in the one-class model, giving identity on the explicit full extension generators. For the two-class model, the normalized image of X is actually F-conjugate to X or X^{-1}, because its commuting reflection is in the other full section class. The explicit quotient X to r, v to s, w to 1 sends both all-unit transporter formulas to r^mu, so conjugacy forces mu modulo every integer n to be plus or minus one. A finite-intersection argument couples these signs to a single global sign. The two exact commuting order-two automorphisms realize all four classes. No exhaustion of arbitrary negative-involution conjugacy orbits is asserted. D65 completes the one-class multiplier calculation. The IA kernel for arbitrary unrecognized involutions remains unresolved.
computational_checks: code/part_c/standard_negative_centralizers_d64.py and its adjacent JSON/stdout check the actual free-word identities and both dihedral transporter images. The full all-modulus and centralizer arguments are algebraic and do not follow from finite checks alone.
